component: Related-item removal Promise and dialog completion

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original removeAccount function awaits searchLoginsAsync but calls removeLoginAsync without awaiting or returning its Promise. The dialog waits for removeAccount before re-enabling its accept button, so that boundary does not include completion or rejection of the final login deletion. The fixed accepted implementation awaits removeLoginAsync within the same try/catch. This is a historical-versus-accepted source distinction; no race, deletion failure, test result or runtime cure was reproduced, and earlier resource removals are not rolled back by that catch.
title: The initial account-removal completion does not await the last login deletion
